mapper.sql: id, product_id, buyer_id, quantity, total_price, status, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (product_id, buyer_id, farmer_id, quantity, total_price, status, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{farmerId}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, GETDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.product_id, o.buyer_id, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.status, o.created_at, fp.farmer_id, fp.name AS product_name, fp.price AS product_price FROM orders o LEFT JOIN farmer_product fp ON o.product_id = fp.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.product_id, o.buyer_id, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.status, o.created_at, fp.farmer_id, fp.name AS product_name, fp.price AS product_price FROM orders o LEFT JOIN farmer_product fp ON o.product_id = fp.id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT o.id, o.product_id, o.buyer_id, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.status, o.created_at, fp.farmer_id, fp.name AS product_name, fp.price AS product_price FROM orders o INNER JOIN farmer_product fp ON o.product_id = fp.id WHERE fp.farmer_id = #{farmerId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
